description:
List a site's URLs synchronously (POST /map), each with a type classification plus title and
description when known.
Cheap. Use it to size up a site before crawl_start, or when only the URL list is needed.
API docs: https://apidocs.pline.ai/guides/endpoints/map

ignore_query_parameters.description: Exclude URLs carrying query strings. Default true.

include_subdomains.description: Include subdomains of the registrable domain. Default true.

sitemap.description: include: sitemaps, search fallback only when none exist; only: sitemaps alone; skip: search only.

timeout.description: Whole-request budget in ms; the service answers 504 when exceeded.

url.description: Base website URL to discover URLs for.

name: map_site
